title: Second trip to Andorra with the same guide!
text: This was our second tour to Andorra with the same guide, Adrian. He was our a year ago on a trip with our grandkids. We went again this year to experience the fall colors. Adrian is a terrific guide. He is a safe driver and very attentive. Be remembered what we saw on our last visit and he included some new things for us to see. It was a wonderful experience.
author: TJMcHugh

title: A dream come true
text: Our tour with Adrian was exceptional. He arrived promptly at our hotel to meet our party, and his knowledge of Spain, Andorra, and France was impressive. Two members of our group had mobility limitations, and he went above and beyond to ensure they could fully enjoy the experience while minimizing the amount of walking required. I would highly recommend this tour from Barcelona Y Day Trips, it is money well spent.
author: E5139PVnatalief

title: Great Tour of Andorra from Barcelona
text: We had a great private tour of Andorra from Barcelona.  Our driver/tour guide, Adrian was wonderful!  He was very knowledgeable, and took us to all of the photo spots, places to eat, have a drink, etc.  We even played 9 holes of golf!  Adrian was very accommodating, and we had a very good time!
author: vinces828

title: Top travel experience, worth every penny
text:
This was one of my top travel experience ever. Andorra was a lovely country, and the Pyrenees are one of the more beautiful areas I've ever visited. But the real gem on this trip was our guide. 
Adrian was friendly, knowledgeable, and accommodating. He took us to great spots for photos that were off the beaten path for larger tours, and the personal attention ensured that the trip was perfectly tailored to our specific tastes. He presented a wealth of knowledge, made excellent recommendations, and took great care of us throughout the trip.

title: Andorra History & Day Tour from Barcelona
text:
This was a fantastic tour and Adrian was our great guide!  We visited and saw everything on the agenda and more.  We had asked  to see specific things and Adrian was able to accommodate these as well.  We had lunch in a local restaurant and ate delicious local cuisine.

Adrian knew the history and current events of Andorra, as well as its economy, government, and exports. He told about some of these in a story format to leave the finale when we visited the next place.  This added intrigue and some had funny endings!

title: Thank You Adrian!
text:
We took a day long trip to Andorra from Barcelona with our private guide Adrian, a real pip. He was an eager photographer and took over a dozen pictures of Kathleen and I together with a wide variety of bucolic backgrounds across our travels, which took just over twelve hours. Adrian knows Andorra well and was an expert guide and driver, he took us through the tiny country and even out into the French side of the Pyrenees a bit before we returned to Barcelona just before sunset.
